judgement.reason: LobeHub is a single Next.js web app on PostgreSQL with S3, so the changes-needed outcome is acceptable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares redis (redis:7-alpine) in docker-compose/deploy/docker-compose.yml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared redis service is Redis, which Deployz provides, and the app reaches it through the REDIS_URL setting.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume fts-search-reindex-state:/app/.elasticsearch-reindex (docker-compose/deploy/docker-compose.yml lobe)
reviews.reason: The volume holds Elasticsearch reindex state through ES_REINDEX_STATE_DIR, and no shown line proves that this state is disposable or stored elsewhere.
